claims.value: <bait>_<batch>_<FOR|REV>_pool<k>_<cell line>_<FLAG-bait|EV>; 157 pooled SILAC triplets, 3 sources (cultures/IPs) each
claims.evidence: Supp. Methods 9-12: each bait IP'd from SILAC-labelled cells grown "in biological triplicate for each condition (Light, Medium, Heavy; n=3 forward and n=3 reverse samples per bait per cell line)"; "SILAC triplets (light, medium, heavy) were pooled before MS analyses", "the MS analyses include 2 technical replicates for each sample (i.e. the same sample was analyzed twice by MS)". Physical pooled sample identified from the raw headers: runs of one batch/bait/direction acquired from the same autosampler vial on the same instrument PC (e.g. LDY1603 MEK F-1/F-2 vial GB1, F-3/F-4 GB2, F-5/F-6 GB3; explicit <bio>-<tech> names such as ALI1408 GRB2-F-1-1/F-1-2 share vial RA6), or whose header original acquisition name is another deposited run (LDY1275 *-F-12 -> *-F-1), or that share an explicit <bio> index (ALI1428 RAB5A measured on two instruments) are one sample; they share a source name and are numbered comment[technical replicate] 1..n in slot order. No vial is shared by two bait/direction groups of one batch (check in pools.json). Biological replicate = running number of distinct pooled samples within each factor group (bait x cell line; empty vector x cell line), so every culture has its own number (spec README.adoc:330, campaign rule 3).

claims.value: FOR: SILAC heavy = HCT116 FLAG-bait, SILAC medium = HKE-3 empty vector, SILAC light = HKE-3 FLAG-bait; REV: SILAC heavy = HKE-3 FLAG-bait, SILAC medium = HCT116 empty vector, SILAC light = HCT116 FLAG-bait
claims.evidence: Deposited PRIMESDataSILACLabelExperiemntaldesign.txt: "FORWARD Experiment (FOR, F)  HCT116(Bait) | HKE3 (Empty Vector) | HKE3 (Bait)" and "REVERSE Experiement (REV, R)  HKE3 (Bait) | HCT116 (Empty Vector) | HCT116 (Bait)" under columns Heavy | Medium | Light. Supp. Methods 9 table: "FORWARD HCT116 Heavy, (Bait) HKE3, Medium (Empty Vector) HKE3 Light, (Bait); REVERSE HCT116 Light, (Bait) HCT116, Medium (Empty Vector) HKE3 Heavy, (Bait)" - the two explicit sources agree. Direction from the file-name token FOR/F/For or REV/R/Rev. Data check (bait_check.txt): the FLAG bait is enriched over the medium (empty-vector) channel in heavy and light in every direction (median log2 H/M 1.6-5.1, L/M 2.0-4.7; e.g. CASP9, HDAC1, BRAF, MAP2K1, RAF1, PRKCA/E/G). Orientation check: where bait levels differ between the cell lines the difference follows the swap - PEBP1 FOR H/M 1.57 < L/M 3.14 and REV H/M 4.32 > L/M 2.79; RAC1 FOR 2.06 < 4.35, REV 4.27 > 2.41; PRKCA FOR 1.62 < 3.28, REV 3.13 > 2.05 - i.e. the HKE-3 bait channel is light in FOR and heavy in REV, as stated.

Filled by sdrf-tools build for ms-proteomics.

limitations: No MaxQuant mqpar.xml, summary.txt or parameters.txt is deposited (only proteinGroups.txt), so the experiment->raw-file assignment of the searches is not recorded; the correlation matrices show that the MaxQuant experiment numbering is not the alphabetical raw order (corr_BRAF.txt). Coverage is therefore checked by counts: for every bait/direction with raws in this deposit, the number of raws equals the number of MaxQuant experiments of that bait, except the cases listed below.

Physical pooled-sample grouping rests on the autosampler vial and the original acquisition name in the raw headers (same vial on the same instrument = re-injection). Pools of different batches are treated as independent cultures (each gets its own biological replicate number); the deposit does not state whether a pool was ever re-run in a later batch. Several bait/directions have 5-10 runs instead of the 6 (3 biological x 2 technical) the paper describes.

Whether the medium-channel empty-vector IP of a pool was prepared separately for each bait pool of a batch is not stated; one EV source per pool is annotated (scheme in Supp. Methods 9 gives one EV per triplet).

comment[collision energy] = not available on Q Exactive Plus rows: the HCD NCE is not stated; the MS instrument-method stream deeper in the raw files was not read. comment[fragment mass tolerance] = 0.5 Da on all rows follows the single search-wide statement of Supp. Methods 12; if MaxQuant used its FTMS default for the QE spectra, the QE value would differ (no mqpar.xml deposited).
Instrument: PRIDE and the paper say Q-Exactive; raw headers say Q Exactive Plus, which is used.
Some run-name suffixes are unexplained and kept as separate pooled samples: _U (ALI0802 BRAF), 1X/3X (LDY0971 VAV1), -BIS (LDY0905 REV), CSK-2 / SRC-2 (ALI1416).

characteristics[cell type] = not available: no cell type is stated (PRIDE "epithelial cell" is a submitter dropdown; Cellosaurus gives none). characteristics[passage number] and [sample storage temperature] not stated.

PXD016505 and PXD016512 are companion deposits of one AP-MS study (different baits; 17 RAC1 raws deposited in both). Further AP-MS deposits PXD016461-PXD016465 (and PXD016549 expression profiling, PXD016431 phosphoproteomics) are listed in the paper but not annotated here. Some proteinGroups experiment counts exceed the raws deposited here and the excess is unexplained (not verified to be raws in those deposits): PDPK1 FOR/REV 7 experiments each with no PDPK1 raw in this deposit

Shared RAC1 rows: the 17 RAC1 raws deposited in both PXD016505 and PXD016512 have identical rows in both SDRFs except characteristics[biological replicate] of the SILAC medium (empty-vector) sources: empty-vector pools are numbered across all baits of each file, so the same 11 EV sources are numbered 79-84 in PXD016505 and 41-46 in PXD016512. Each file is internally consistent (1..n without gaps per factor group); the numbers are not comparable across the two files.

Excluded raw (recorded in BLOCKED.md): LDY1357-S24-A-PRKCA-R-4_010.raw - 39,754-byte stub (FTP Content-Length 39754; PRIDE fileSizeBytes 39754): raw header only, no scans, so nothing could be searched; header name LDY1357-S24-A-PRKCA-R-4.raw (vial BE8) - the deposited LDY1357-S24-A-PRKCA-R-4.raw (header name with _140214143506 suffix) is the complete acquisition of that slot

PRKCA REV: 9 searchable raws (ALI1442-S18-A-KCA-R on Q Exactive Plus; LDY1208 REV-1/-2, LDY1261 R-1/-2, LDY1357 R-1..R-4 on Velos) vs 8 KCAREV experiments. ALI1442-S18-A-KCA-R.raw was searched: KCAREV1 summed intensity 4.68e11 is the Q Exactive Plus scale (as KCAFOR1 4.65e11 = ALI1442-S02-A-KCA-F, KCEFOR1/KCEREV1/KCGFOR1/KCGREV1 3.4-4.3e11), while KCAREV2-8 are <=2.2e10 (exp_intensity_PRKCA.txt). So 7 Velos experiments cover 8 Velos raws: one Velos PRKCA REV run is unaccounted for (unsearched, or two runs merged into one experiment); which one is not determinable without mqpar.xml. All 8 are annotated with the search parameters.
